title: Eternal inflation and the multiverse
example_questions: What happened before the Big Bang?
summary: In many models of cosmic inflation, inflation never ends everywhere at once. Quantum fluctuations keep some regions inflating forever while others stop and become bubble universes like ours. The result is an endless multiverse of bubbles, possibly with different physical laws.
support_note: Inflation is the leading early universe theory; whether it is eternal and creates a multiverse is debated.
what_happens: Inflation ends in patches, forming bubble universes
Between bubbles, space keeps inflating forever
objections: Hard or impossible to test directly
The measure problem makes probabilities ambiguous
